name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.70 / build 71 corrects Android encrypted Help Bot history reopening without clearing or migrating existing records. New messages begin saving immediately; closing/backgrounding flushes unfinished drafts. Clear Chat is removed, including legacy saved menu actions. History remains patient-scoped on this device after logout, without automatic expiry or message-count truncation. A lost original encryption key cannot be reconstructed. Mobile and website human-chat typing rows use circular avatars and scroll with messages without a sticky strip or forced jump when reading earlier messages. Nonempty visible drafts renew the existing private typing marker. Website Back/minimize keeps the guest conversation; refresh/page exit still ends it. No backend, desktop or database deployment is included. Physical-phone recovery, installation and push delivery are not verified. Existing development signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval. Install over a compatible existing app without uninstalling or clearing app data.
